responsePromise: Quote back within a few hours, seven days a week.

process.detail: A couple of photos and your suburb is enough for a guide price.
We get up there, check the frame and the flashings, and give you a fixed price in writing.
Most homes are a few days. We sheet and make watertight as we go, so you are never left open.

faq.q: How much does a new roof cost?
faq.a: It comes down to roof area, pitch, access and whether the frame needs work. Use the guide above for a range, then we confirm on site.
Metal is lighter, faster to install and better on a low pitch. Tile suits some houses and some streets better. We will tell you which yours wants.

faq.q: What happens if it rains mid-job?
faq.a: We only strip what we can make watertight that day. Your house does not get left open overnight.
Yes. We can quote in the format your insurer wants and deal with the assessor.
